The reported transaction involved the Reporting Person's receipt of 69,000 restricted stock units ("RSUs") granted by the Board of Directors of Barnwell Industries, Inc. on October 30, 2026 as a non-employee director award pursuant to the Barnwell Industries, Inc. 2018 Equity Incentive Plan, as amended and restated. Each RSU represents a contingent right to receive one share of common stock upon vesting. The RSUs vest ratably in three substantially equal annual installments on each of the first three anniversaries of the grant date, subject to the Reporting Person's continued service as a director. || The total reported in Column 5 includes (i) the 69,000 newly awarded RSUs, (ii) 43,860 RSUs granted on December 3, 2025, 14,474 of which have vested, and (iii) 39,814 shares of common stock.
This represents the weighted average price of shares at a range between 72.3600 and 74.2400. The reporting person undertakes to provide full share price information upon request.
